correctness.rationale: All facets of the intrinsic canonical symmetric edge polytope P_(p,q) are signed, centered potentials on one bipartite part (two duplicate labels). Norm square of a projected sign normal on part size s and sum t is s-t²/(p+q), giving maximal M=h-(h mod2)/(p+q). Central symmetry proves an optimal centered ball of r=M^(-1/2). Active sign vectors annihilate the affine span of all radius-r centers; strict slack of the other finite constraints at zero proves this whole affine hull. Balanced even signs span the within-part contrast directions; odd near-balanced signs span full part, yielding unequal dimensions ell or ell-1 and equal dimensions 1 or 0 as claimed. The positive monotone endpoint bound in equal even case gives |a|<=(1-sqrt(1-2/m²))/2. Sample independent exact rational sign-normal norm checks for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4) agree. The claim is mathematically correct, but not original.
